programs.title: The 90-Day Fit & Strong Program
programs.subtitle: Cardio, strength, and toning, with your pelvic floor on the team.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Gentle full-body sessions to wake everything up.

days.title: Cardio Kick
days.intention: Today builds the engine: rhythmic, energetic movement you can actually enjoy. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

days.title: Tone Zone
days.intention: Today's toning session is equal parts burn and fun. Lean into both. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Small, honest efforts today are what your body remembers tomorrow.

days.title: Muscle Matters
days.intention: Today is focused strength work: controlled reps that add up to real change. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.

days.title: Heart-Rate Hello
days.intention: We move with pace today: light on your joints, honest on your lungs. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Notice how you feel before and after; that awareness is progress too.

days.title: Living-Room Circuit
days.intention: We train smart today: full-body work in a small space with zero equipment. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. You are exactly where you need to be in this process.

days.title: Athletic Hour
days.intention: This is the week's big effort. Bring your energy and spend it all. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Give yourself full credit for pressing play today.

days.title: The Exhale Day
days.intention: Today is deliberately lighter: long stretches, soft breath, and space to notice your progress. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Build the daily movement habit that carries the next 12 weeks.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Show up, sweat a little, repeat. Keeping going is the goal.
